events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from the album that kicked off Britpop?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic event of the 1960s counterculture, began on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since Woodstock brought three days of peace and music to a generation. Which legendary performance from the festival still resonates with you?

events.title: Elvis Presley tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering the King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music and legacy continue to inspire. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur shooting anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Three decades on, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message remains undeniable. Remembering the shooting that tragically preceded his death.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix tribute
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon. What's the Hendrix track that truly showcases his genius for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Beyond the legendary zebra crossing, what's your favourite moment from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have shaped decades of rock. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your top track from LG?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the UK release of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: Original iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, which 007 actor is your definitive Bond, and what's your favourite theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: John Lennon would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. Its diverse tracks proved they were pushing boundaries. What's your standout song from it?
